stops.note: Makassan fishermen from Sulawesi sailed to northern Australia each monsoon from about the 1700s to gather sea cucumbers for the Chinese market, until South Australia banned the trade in 1906
Matthew Flinders met a Makassan trepang fleet off Arnhem Land in 1803 and recorded its commander, Pobassoo

current_meaning: a sea cucumber, dried and eaten especially in Chinese cuisine
